Lore: Relic Hat (Bound)

Pekoe Quint's, and it explains a great deal about Pekoe Quint. It has the following Powers:

  • Disguise: Cast @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.rk2GSVwSxOLSOozU]{Mirage} on yourself at will to change your appearance. The illusion ends if the hat leaves your head.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
